implementationQualificationSemantics.NOT_REQUIRED: No separate shipping-product qualification gate is required for this role decision; ordinary compatibility/CI verification still applies where relevant.
implementationQualificationSemantics.REQUIRED: The role is already selected, but it must not be considered product-ready until the exact selected package/version/binary/platform closure passes the applicable implementation/product qualification.
implementationQualificationSemantics.RUNNING: Exact implementation/product qualification is in progress.
implementationQualificationSemantics.PASSED: Exact implementation/product qualification has passed for the recorded product/platform scope.
implementationQualificationSemantics.FAILED: Exact implementation/product qualification failed for the recorded product/platform scope.
implementationQualificationSemantics.DEFERRED: The role/implementation is outside the current Foundation implementation scope.

baselinePolicy.rule: Foundation Implementation Plan must not contain PRIMARY_CANDIDATE or UNRESOLVED dependency roles. Residual platform/native/source-less risk is represented by implementationQualification, not by reopening the role by default.
baselinePolicy.replacementRule: An ADOPTED role is an implementation directive. Replacing it requires concrete blocker evidence and an authority update in the same change.
baselinePolicy.versionRule: Architecture freezes responsibility lines, not eternal patch numbers. Exact direct versions are refreshed from current registry/upstream evidence and exact-pinned in the pnpm Catalog.
